newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada dollar ends firmer, quiet overnight seen.
newsitem.headline: Canada dollar ends firmer, quiet overnight seen.

text.p: * Canada's dollar ended firmer around C$1.3730 (US$0.7283) on Wednesday from Tuesday's close at C$1.3783 (US$0.7255), holding most of its gains from overnight rally * Canada unit traded quietly during North American session as markets debate possibility of another U.S. rate hike, traders said * Quiet Thursday session seen ahead of Easter holiday weekend
Analysts said, however, that the Canada dollar's roller-coaster ride of the past three months was not over, especially with another U.S. rate hike possible in May.
The currency was under pressure ahead of Tuesday's 25 basis point increase in U.S. interest rates by the Federal Reserve. The Bank of Canada has not followed with a hike in Canadian rates.
The central bank's ability to resist the Fed would depend on whether the Canada dollar deteriorated in the short term, said Mario Angastiniotis, economist with MMS International.
